title: High-Fidelity Dashboard Tile States & Accessibility Pass — stakeholder review and redline list
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: This ticket captures the final pass on high-fidelity dashboard tile states and an accessibility review before handing off to engineering. The goal is to finalize hover/active/focus/disabled states for all dashboard tile variants (compact, regular, and expanded), confirm microcopy for cost breakdown affordances, and produce a redline list and dev-ready Figma frames. This work follows the interactive prototype session (see attachments) and incorporates feedback from PM, Eng, and Design Ops.
acceptance_criteria: 1) All tile states (hover, pressed, keyboard focus, disabled, loading) are represented in Figma for compact/regular/expanded variants. 2) Contrast and focus treatments meet WCAG AA for text >= 14px and 3:1 for UI components per internal a11y baseline. 3) Microcopy for hover tooltips and the 'View cost breakdown' affordance is approved by PM. 4) Redline annotations created (spacing, token values, elevation) and exported as PDF. 5) A single engineering handoff PRD doc with links to Figma frames, CSS token mappings, and QA checklist is attached.
design_decisions: - Prefer 1px subtle inset border on focused tile rather than using only shadow to ensure keyboard focus visibility. - Use token 'surface-02' with 12% elevation for compact tiles to preserve color relationships with the cost sparkline. - Replace generic 'Details' microcopy with 'View cost breakdown' to reduce ambiguity. - Tooltip delays reduced to 120ms to match quick hover patterns in other consoles. - For disabled tiles, use 60% opacity on primary text and hide interactive affordances but keep structure for screen readers.
open_questions: - Do we want to expose a keyboard shortcut for 'open tile detail' from summary tiles? (PM decision needed) - Should the cost sparklines pause animations when the user opens more than 3 tiles simultaneously? (performance trade-off with GPU) - Confirm whether the compact tile should truncate service names at 20 or 24 chars (engineering impact on grid alignment).
stakeholders_feedback: 2026-03-03 | Sofia Martinez (PM): Approves 'View cost breakdown' copy but asks for a version with 'Show cost breakdown' to test in AB. Wants the tooltip copy to be testable in analytics.

2026-03-04 | Oliver Park (Eng): Requests explicit CSS token list for focus ring and notes potential conflicts with existing runtime theme overrides. Flags potential 8px vs 12px focus padding mismatch.
2026-03-05 | Maya Singh (Design Ops): Requests redline export with pixel-grid snap and an accessibility checklist attached to the handoff doc.
2026-03-06 | Customer Success (via note): Customer pilot (beta) asked for larger hit target on mobile tiles; suggests increasing min-height for touch by 8px.
2026-03-07 | Legal (brief): No copy issues flagged but asks that microcopy variants be tracked in a single source of truth for localization.
2026-03-09 | Liam Chen (Design - assignee): Reviewed color contrast; compact tile body copy fails 3:1 at 12px on certain vendor gray — will iterate on token values and re-export.
next_steps: 1) Update Figma frames to include keyboard focus states and the alternate microcopy 'Show cost breakdown' as a variant (due 2026-03-11). 2) Run a quick a11y contrast audit and update tokens (Liam). 3) Produce annotated redline PDF and attach to PRD (Design Ops). 4) Create engineering implant ticket ENG-2985 listing CSS tokens, measurements, and animation timings. 5) Schedule 30-minute handoff with ENG and PM (proposed 2026-03-12).
